title: Make or Break or Total Chaos

text_block_list.text: Christmas Day...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, welcome welcome! All dressed up!? Good kids keep juice in the right hand and a cracker in the left~!

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wow, it’s really luxurious...! I’m glad I dressed up! Did you get your cracker? I’ve got orange juice~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright alright, everyone ready~~?? Then let’s go!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We’ve got tons of fun stuff! Board games, cards, cosplay, challenge games, and a big gift exchange!

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Waaah!! So the rumors about all the prep were true! Hey, which one are you joining? Ugh, what do I pick~!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall host a game that combines all activities into one... the “Life-sized Sugoroku.”

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume
text_block_list.text: L-life-sized sugoroku!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Look at the cafeteria entrance! See the “Start Point”? We’re gonna use the whole academy and play sugoroku in style!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: We’ve prepared a full-scale course so everyone can enjoy themselves.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Rules are simple. Participants become the game pieces, rolling this die as you move along the board...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Start from the cafeteria, circle around the campus, head into the central plaza... and aim for the gym as the goal.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Each tile contains some sort of mission.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Some tiles have special games prepared, so look forward to them.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: We, the event staff, will guide you. Feel free to ask us anything during play. And the “Game Master” will be...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Me. Indulge yourselves in entertainment to your heart’s content.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well then everyone, enjoy yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Everyone is progressing smoothly... Now, here comes the first special point.

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: One, two, three! “Special tile here”? Um, enter the classroom...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Welcome to the special tile... Care to play with me?

text_block_list.name: Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wh-where is this...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Here you can experience one of six games at random. Rules are simple.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: If you beat me, you get a present. If I lose, I drink a cup of extremely bitter tea as punishment.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, if you lose... you know what happens, right? Hmph, don’t be so scared. First we’ll roll the die to decide the game—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: My my... that explanation has a flaw. If the challenger loses, what exactly happens...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Tch, well it’s already too late once you start the sugoroku. Want to hear it? The thrilling condition?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Fine, I’ll tell you. If you lose this match...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You don’t get a present!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...So it’s no-risk?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, challenger? First let’s decide the game with this. Don’t get stiff. Should I roll the die for you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Let’s take it easy. “1,” huh? You’re lucky. “Hellish Thrill Judgment.” A simple beginner-friendly game.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: These two identical-looking juices. One is delicious, the other is sour enough to numb you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You and I each choose one and drink it. Delicious one wins. Best of five—first to three wins. Easy, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Now... choose.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Fourth game. If yours is delicious, you win. Ready—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ngh... haaah—sour... bleh... Impressive, miss. Take the present.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: First time playing poker? Alright, I’ll teach you. Nothing to fear. Beginners get lucky sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Check the guide to see hand rankings. Strongest at the top. After that, well, it’s luck. Aim for whatever you want and build it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Brilliant. Hah! Hahahaha! A “Straight Flush” on your first try!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you win. Take the present. And I get the punishment.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ghh—aaahhh... hits hard... extremely bitter...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Rolled a “4”... then your game is “Baccarat.” Five rounds total. Winner is whoever has more chips in the end.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: First... let’s bet. Go bold, yeah? Momentum is everything.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Incredible luck you’ve got!! Looks like your win is sealed... or so I’d say.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Bonus chance. Final game—if you go all-in and win, I’ll double your present.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Of course, lose and you lose everything... but that’s what makes your heart pound, right? Now... let’s feel the thrill...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Cards... open!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Total “9”! Hah—hahaha! The best hand here! Magnificent, I surrender! Take the present doubled!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Good times. Let’s play again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Alright, who’s the next challenger!? This is the forced-stop special tile! Let’s have a thrilling match...!
